def mo_algorithm(a={{arr}}, queries={{queries}}):
    n = len(a); B = max(1, int(n**0.5))
    Q = [(l, r, i) for i, (l, r) in enumerate(queries)]
    Q.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0]//B, x[1] if (x[0]//B)%2==0 else -x[1]))
    cnt = {}; distinct = 0; ans = [0]*len(queries)
    l = 0; r = -1
    def add(x):
        nonlocal distinct
        cnt[x] = cnt.get(x, 0) + 1
        if cnt[x] == 1: distinct += 1
    def rem(x):
        nonlocal distinct
        cnt[x] -= 1
        if cnt[x] == 0: distinct -= 1
    for ql, qr, idx in Q:
        while r < qr: r += 1; add(a[r])
        while l > ql: l -= 1; add(a[l])
        while r > qr: rem(a[r]); r -= 1
        while l < ql: rem(a[l]); l += 1
        ans[idx] = distinct
    return ans
